summary: Mobile IPv6 signaling between a mobile node and its home agent is normally secured with IPsec and IKE. This experimental RFC proposes an alternative security framework that uses TLS to establish keying material and other bootstrapping information, for Mobile IPv6 and Dual-Stack Mobile IPv6.

eli5.summary: Usually a traveler and home use one special lock. This offers a second kind of lock that lots of programs already know how to use.
